snippet.title: FiNE ME - Gameplay Teaser by Authogin
snippet.description:
Play Find Me, a hide and seek horror game where a young girl is hiding in a house and wants to be found! So is... something else. Search the rooms, pay attention and listen closely. Find her to complete a round. Complete 8 rounds to win. Just make sure you don't find... them.

Wishlist today here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5285600/FiND_ME/

More from Authogin: https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Authogin
